119944.name: Ganeinu Day Camp

earlier.where: the Bergsteins' Bais Chabad (Chabad of Farmington Hills), where it began as a neighborhood camp, for its first two or three summers

119944.note: Detroit Jewish News (1 Feb 2018, 'Summer Smiles - Ganeinu Day Camp Celebrates 30 Years', Judy Greenwald): 'This year, Ganeinu Day Camp, a 5-acre campsite in West Bloomfield ... will celebrate 30 years'; Chaya Bergstein: 'Ganeinu as it is today started when my high school-age daughter Hadassah and a friend started a camp program with kids from the neighborhood at our Bais Chabad. That summer, 40 children came. The next summer, it was 80, and the following year, 120. At that point, we purchased our present property, formerly Bloomfield Nursery and Day Camp'. So 1988 (counted back, medium); a Jewish News article of 31 July 1992 is said to put its first summer 'four years ago' (search excerpt, not opened: the archive now blocks downloads). It shares its place with the Ganeinu preschool (1991). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

4881009.name: Chabad of Canton
4881009.note: Its Chanukah campaign of 2022 ('Double The Light! 2022', jewishcanton.com): 'This Chanukah we are celebrating 20 years of Chabad Chai Center's Light!' So 2002 (counted back, medium). IRS exempt-organization file: 'CHAI CENTER OF CANTON INC' (c/o Menachem M Horowitz, 580 Washington St, Canton), ruling March 2007, later. Was 2020 (its chabad.org listing year, low). Its chabad.org listing went up 2020-10-18, so it existed by then. Director: Mendy Horowitz.

164086.name: Chabad of the South Shore
164086.note: Chabad.org (1 July 2025, 'Celebrating a Bar Mitzvah at 98 Years Old'), on Rabbi Levi and Mushky Lezell: 'Having established Chabad of the South Shore in 2015, they are based in the cranberry bogs and colonial harbors of Plymouth, Mass.' IRS exempt-organization file: 'SOUTH SHORE CHABAD LUBAVITCH INC' (c/o Rabbi Levi Lezell, 4 Court St, Plymouth), ruling April 2016. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-08-24, eleven years before them, so the listing was first an earlier center's: the IRS file has 'CHABAD-OHR SHALOM OF THE SOUTH SHORE INC' (c/o Rabbi A. Brashevitsky, Weymouth), ruling October 2001; when it ended, and whether it is the same organization, is not known. As with Chabad of West Davie, the year is the present center's; the 2001 one is kept here for the owner to decide.

118781.name: Hebrew School
118781.note: Canadian Jewish News (on CrownHeights.info, 17 May 2006, 'Chabad Richmond Hill to get its own building'): 'The rabbi and his wife, Toby, moved to Richmond Hill in 1997, and got the local Chabad off the ground in their home, using it as synagogue and preschool' (the listing's address, 112 Stave Crescent, is that home); 'The organization also runs a Sunday Hebrew school from senior kindergarten to Grade 7 at Silver Pines Public School, with just over 200 students.' So the Hebrew school began between 1997 and its chabad.org listing (July 22 2004). Lead: its old-directory number (mosad-id 3458) points to an entry made about 2001-02. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.
